opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they attend. Award value and application frequency vary with membership category.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at The Physiological Society's own meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers conference registration and attendance at meeting dinners, with a contribution toward travel and accommodation on presentation of receipts. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Funds must be used within 12 months of award; resources made available to the Society for wider dissemination.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Funds animal costs, experimental consumables, and small equipment purchases (excluding PCs).

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society Representatives and members; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Events must take place after the application window closes.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. Funds paid to the institution via invoice, not to individuals.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society; members will normally only be awarded this funding once during their membership.
opportunities.summary: Support for postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries, but not staff salaries. Started in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles in physiological teaching or research. Funds must be used within 6 months of award and paid to the institution via invoice.
